title: Environment-assisted squeezing in a coherently driven non-Hermitian degenerate parametric oscillator
summary: Environment-assisted approaches to nonclassical light offer a practical path to strong squeezing in imperfect, lossy platforms. In this paper, we study a degenerate parametric oscillator in which a coherently driven cavity is coupled to a broadband squeezed reservoir via a single-port mirror. At the same time, the intracavity dynamics include non-Hermitian (gain-loss-imbalanced) terms. Within input--output theory, we obtain closed-form expressions for the steady-state quadrature variances, the output squeezing spectrum, and the power spectrum, and map their dependence on the reservoir…
